subject: Request: competitive trial credit match & short extension for RFP
messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@benchmarklabs.com>
To: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Trial credits for head-to-head RFP evaluation

Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked promising. We have a fast-moving RFP for a benchmarking pilot against two incumbent providers; the procurement team just surfaced that our preferred setup requires a 30% longer evaluation window and a test budget that matches the incumbent's promotional credits.

Quick asks: can Redwood extend our trial window from 14 to 45 days and grant an additional 150k token credit for the pilot so we can run parallel, full-load scenarios? Procurement wants written confirmation they can see usage logs and token invoices for audit.

We need everything signed off by Jan 8 to make the vendor short-list. I've attached a spreadsheet with the test matrix and current competitor credit offer. Happy to hop on a 20m call if helpful.

—Alex
Benchmark Labs
Attachments: benchmark-test-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@benchmarklabs.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial credits for head-to-head RFP evaluation

Alex — thanks for the clear asks and the test matrix. We're excited to participate in the bake-off.

Short answers up front: we can extend the pilot to 45 days and provision an incremental 150,000 token credit for the RFP, subject to a short MAP and an audit access clause for usage logs (read-only).

What I'll do next:
- Share a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) that includes the extension dates, credit tranche release schedule, and observability access.
- Coordinate a procurement-friendly evidence package (SOC2 excerpt + tokenized usage export) for HealthGrid's review.
- Confirm billing/overage treatment if you exceed the credit tranche.

Can you confirm the start date you want us to use (first model call)? If you can start by Jan 4 we can fit the whole run and provide a summary report by Feb 17.

I'll loop in Marcus to confirm the credit approval and any guardrails.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachments: 2026-12-28-Benchmark-MAP.pdf (MAP stub)

From: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
To: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial credits for head-to-head RFP evaluation

Irene — reviewed Alex's matrix and the competitor offer. These are reasonable ask levels for a proof-of-concept that could convert into a dedicated account. I'm approving the 150k token top-up, with two guardrails:

1) Credits released in two tranches: 75k at kickoff and 75k after midpoint review (day 22) with a short health check.
2) We require procurement to sign the standard evidence access addendum (read-only logs + SLA summary). No exceptions on audit access.

Also flagging: if they run heavy long-context tests we should apply Redwood Optimize recommendations (suggest 8-bit quantized variant for cost). Please include usage forecast numbers in the MAP so finance can pre-authorize.

Marcus
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachment: healthgrid-questions.xlsx (procurement Qs stub)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Alex Reed <alex.reed@benchmarklabs.com>, procurement@healthgrid.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial credits for head-to-head RFP evaluation

Looping in approval. Irene/Marcus: proceed with the 45-day extension and the 150k token pool split into the two tranches Marcus described.

Conditions:
- Procurement must sign the Evidence Access Addendum and the short SOW that limits usage to the evaluation matrix.
- Any change in scope (additional model variants or sustained live traffic) will require a commercial amendment.
- Provide a midpoint summary and final comparative report — include token-level cost delta vs competitor.

Alex/procurement: I'll ask our contracts team to prepare a 1-page amendment and a DocuSign link; please route to procurement@healthgrid.ai for signature.

If procurement needs an earlier start, we can accelerate kickoff paperwork but credits will only be provisioned once the addendum is signed.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachment: docuSign-link (generated)
